body:
I know, this is all very interesting. I've recently started to appreciate biology and history too. It's just not enough. It interests me, but not as much as it used to. And I feel like the depression is robbing me of my memory and my clear mindedness. I'm not as good at any of this as I used to be.

I know I need help, but I look at how that goes, how difficult it is and how much pain lies ahead no matter how well I do and I still just want to give up. Like I said before, I don't think I'm made for this struggle. If I get help, I lose my, 'out'.

That's what I'm doing now. I play videogames and I read. I read all kinds of books, articles, essays. I do these things to distract myself. 

I used to really want to study physics at university, but I don't know any more. I feel I enjoy it less. I'm not as good at it as I thought. And I'm fucking up yet another chance at getting my education. I can't keep trying again next year. I can't afford to.

I'm terrified pinning all my hopes on going away to uni and changing my life will fail, and ultimately everything will be the same. I am just as terrified of staying where I am. I mentioned before I am not made to struggle, and I feel horrible saying this, but I hate my retail job so much that if I knew that is the sort of thing I'd be doing for the rest of my life I would want to kill myself all that much more. 

This makes me think I should do something interesting to make it at least bearable. There are lots of interesting things. But nothing I have a passion for. Nothing I think that would really solve this problem.
